say:0:1710308001:0.text: What a fancy place. Those scholars must have deep pockets.
say:0:1710308001:0.source_cn: 好气派的展览馆。冬青学会真是财力雄厚啊。
say:0:1710308001:0.male: What a fancy place. Those scholars must have deep pockets.
say:0:1710308001:0.female: What a fancy place. Those scholars must have deep pockets.

say:1:1710308002:0.text: Well, they receive government grants, and some of their scholars are wealthy nobles.
say:1:1710308002:0.source_cn: 冬青学会有国家专项拨款，部分成员本身也出身贵族，资金相...
say:1:1710308002:0.male: Well, they receive government grants, and some of their scholars are wealthy nobles.
say:1:1710308002:0.female: Well, they receive government grants, and some of their scholars are wealthy nobles.
